sources.snippet: Overview Ornith-1.5-35B-A3B-MLX is a text-generation reasoning model for coding, tool use, and agent workflows, maintained by ornith-ai. It uses a mixture-of-experts architecture with about 35 billion total parameters and about 3 billion activated parameters per token.
